notes.title: Update v1.003 - Windows ONLY - Crash reporting system
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

from time to time we get reports that game crashes on the launch or at some point and usually it's quite tedious to catch the bug without proper information.

I'm happy to announce that we have integrated crash reporting system in Ace Of Words.

In general if your game crashes, game will generate 3 files in the same folder where your main executable file is:
[list]
[*] OceanMedia-Crash-Instructions.txt

[*] OceanMedia-CrashReport.txt
[*] OceanMedia-CrashDump.dmp
[/list]

First file on the list is obvious, describes what to do in this case.
Other two files is what we need and just simply email them to support@oceanmedia.hr and we'll take it from there.

This will help us a lot to improve the game and cure terminal bugs.

Vedran Klanac,
creator of Ace Of Words

notes.title: Full Release v1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we have decided to go in full release and release the game with new languages.

With this build we are featuring new languages.

Right now, following languages were added:
[list]
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Portugese 
[*] Hrvatski / Croatian
[/list]

Following languages are in preapration and will be released within 10 days:
[list]
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Dutch
[*] Polish
[*] Turkish
[/list]

Also in upcoming weeks we will release Linux and Mac versions of the game.

Once all languages we have planned are out, we will continue working on something
what we think is ultimate goal for this game, that is multiplayer mode.

Note about other languages dictionaries, not same rules for the word set is used as for English due various language specifics.
Also, please note, that dictionaries are not perfect but we think they will serve well to provide good entertainment.
Where we notice serious issues and get reports, we'll make sure to improve them.

Note for players in Croatian language:
Napomena za sve igrače koji igraju na hrvatskom jeziku da igra sadrži varijacije riječi po padežima i rodovima.

Also, we are looking for help to translate User Interface text to proper languages. Right now, all UI text is in english.

Thanks once again on all active feedback, we are making notes and working on improvements and bug fixes.

Vedran Klanac
Ace Of Words creator

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - new game mode and leaderboard added
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

this is MAJOR update as it brings couple of things.

Since we have very good and active discussion on the forums, over the time we figured out what are some points where we can improve the game and how to make it more fun.

This game was at first imagined to run as anagram puzzle with 8 letters. During the discussion in the forum couple of players asked why can not we choose how many letters I want to play with? :) lol

Anyway, we are bringing 6-letter mode with this update as DEFAULT mode and 8-letter mode can be switched to via Options dialog. There's checkbox right below SFX slider.

We have tested this 6-letter mode for last week or so and I must say it feels way more fun. 

With this new mode, it's natural that we bring up also new leaderboard, so here it is.

If you switch the game mode under the Options dialog, on the Main Menu screen appropriate leaderboard will be pulled down from Steam server.

[b]As a result of these changes we had to increase version of the save game file, so older save game won't work for you.[/b]

Besides these major things, we fixed an issue which have forced game to run in windowed mode even if you try to switch to full screen via Options.

Also dictionary is improved a bit, number of reported words were removed.

Thanks a lot for the active discussion in the Community Hub section, it helps us a lot to improve the game.

Have fun and let us know your feedback.

Vedran Klanac,
Ace Of Words designer

notes.title: Update to dictionary EN
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
just to let you know that we have released small update.

There are improvements to the dictionary, specifically to 3-letter and 4-letter words.

These words have highest frequency so in general most issues with abbrevations and personal names were among this group of words.

We are continuously working on improving the dictionary and hope to update very soon 5-letter and 6-letter words as well.

We are aware that di9ctionary is not perfect and we are reading all your feedback in the discussion section. With each update game should be more enjoyable to play.

Thanks for understanding and we'll keep on updating you on all the developments.

notes.title: Quick update on developments and leaderboard display
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we have been busy in recent weeks as we were dealing with release of Solar Division here on Steam and Zotrix PS4 release.

I have been reading all the discussions and items which have been reported by all of you will be addressed in future updates.

First item is already addressed in short update which was released today and it's related to displaying leaderboards.

Leaderboard displayed in the game, in current version, is relative to your position.
We have removed position numbers to score entries as they make no sense and we added information showing your rank right below the entries.

Here's what's next for Ace Of Words:
[list]
[*] address dictionary issues (what we can at this point)
[*] adding German as next language - localization for UI and dictionary
[*] add button to Main Menu where you can switch leaderboard view from Global to Relative and vice versa
[/list]

Big thing that we are working on is multi-player mode, which is actually what makes this game way more interesting than single player.

My expectation is to have ready mullti-player mode during December or January.

Thanks again for all the reports.
Stay tuned.

Vedran Klanac
creator of Ace Of Words

notes.title: Update - added "Next Puzzle" button
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

this is first update for the game and I have added one feature which sparked as a result on the discussion group.

Once you unlock next puzzle, the progress bar is removed and on that spot is unlocked button "Next Puzzle" which allows you to go immediately to the next puzzle if you don't want to wait timer to go down.

Known issues we are working on:
- resolve randomness of letters generated for the puzzle based on frequence of letters
- keyboard responsivness when punching in letters
